Targ. Ps. XXXIV, 1 (Ms. דעת׳).—ידע מ׳ (euphem. for משתין בקיר) male adult.
Targ. I Sam. XXV, 22; a. fr.—Pl. (fem. form) מַדְּעָן, מִדְּ׳ objects worth knowing or well-known, (used of persons) notables.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 1:13">Targ. O. Deut. I, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 1:15">15</cite> (v. Berl. Massorah, p. 120; h. text <he>ידעים</he>).—V. <cite ref="M01718"><he>מַנְדָּע</he></cite>.
